title: Missed you at the gym
description: Re-engage members who have not visited in weeks with a friendly check-in. Re-engagement WhatsApp template for fitness. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Send around 14 to 21 days of inactivity. Supportive wording works far better than guilt.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we haven't seen you in a while at Acme Fitness. Ready to get back into it? A {{class_name}} session this week is a great restart.
